tasks.label: Build STCM Package
tasks.detail: Build the STCM package with ROS sourced on the distro interpreter + isolated PYTHONUSERBASE

tasks.label: Clean Build STCM Package
tasks.command: rm -rf build/ install/ log/ && export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && colcon build --symlink-install
tasks.detail: Clean all build artifacts and rebuild all packages using the system Python runtime + isolated PYTHONUSERBASE

tasks.label: Launch Semantic Mapping
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch stcm semantic_mapping.launch.py config_file:=$(ros2 pkg prefix stcm)/share/stcm/config/semantic_mapping_params.yaml
tasks.detail: Launch semantic mapping with the config file using the system Python + isolated user base

tasks.label: Launch Semantic Mapping (with Updater)
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch stcm semantic_mapping.launch.py config_file:=$(ros2 pkg prefix stcm)/share/stcm/config/semantic_mapping_params.yaml run_updater:=true
tasks.detail: Launch semantic mapping with the updater enabled on the system Python runtime

tasks.label: Run Semantic Map Builder Node
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm semantic_map_builder --ros-args -p text_prompt:='table . chair . door .' -p graph_output_path:=/tmp/semantic_graph.json
tasks.detail: Run semantic map builder node directly with the isolated system Python user base

tasks.label: Download Model Checkpoints
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm stcm_download_checkpoints
tasks.detail: Download all default model checkpoints after sourcing ROS + workspace on system Python

tasks.label: Test GroundingDINO + MobileSAM
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && python3 stcm/test/test_gdino_sam.py stcm/imgs/image007.png
tasks.detail: Test the perception pipeline on a sample image with the system Python user base

tasks.label: Test Depth Anything
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && python3 stcm/test/test_depth_anything.py stcm/imgs/image00.png
tasks.detail: Test depth estimation on sample image

tasks.label: Run Semantic Graph Simulator
tasks.command: set -a && source .env && set +a && export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && export DISPLAY=:77 && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm_planner semantic_graph_simulator --ros-args -p graph_path:=./output/semantic_graph.json -p model:=gpt-4o -p run_mode:=use_tools
tasks.detail: Run semantic graph simulator with GPT-4o in use_tools mode on display :77 (loads API keys from .env)

tasks.label: Run Language Query Publisher
tasks.command: export PYTHONUSERBASE="${PYTHONUSERBASE:-$HOME/.local/stcm_sys_py310}" && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run stcm_planner language_query_publisher
tasks.detail: Run language query publisher node using the system Python runtime + isolated user base

tasks.label: Install Qwen Models
tasks.detail: Run the Qwen installation script to install Ollama and pull Qwen models

tasks.label: Check Ollama Status
tasks.command: if pgrep -x 'ollama' > /dev/null; then echo '✓ Ollama is running (PID: '$(pgrep -x ollama)')'; ollama --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'Version: unknown'; else echo '✗ Ollama is not running. Start it with: ollama serve'; fi
tasks.detail: Check if Ollama service is running and display version

tasks.label: List Qwen Models
tasks.command: if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Installed Qwen models:' && ollama list | grep -E '(qwen|deepseek-r1|NAME)' || echo 'No Qwen models found'; else echo '✗ Ollama not installed. Run: Install Qwen Models task'; fi
tasks.detail: List all installed Qwen and DeepSeek-R1 models

tasks.label: Start Ollama Server
tasks.command: if pgrep -x 'ollama' > /dev/null; then echo '✓ Ollama is already running (PID: '$(pgrep -x ollama)')'; else echo 'Starting Ollama server...'; nohup ollama serve > /tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & sleep 2 && echo '✓ Ollama started (PID: '$(pgrep -x ollama)') - Logs: /tmp/ollama.log'; fi
tasks.detail: Start Ollama server in background if not already running

tasks.label: Test Qwen Model (Interactive)
tasks.command: MODEL="${input:qwenModel}" && if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Testing $MODEL..." && ollama run $MODEL 'Say hello in one sentence.'; else echo '✗ Ollama not installed'; fi
tasks.detail: Run a quick test query against a selected Qwen model interactively

tasks.label: Pull Qwen Model
tasks.command: MODEL="${input:qwenModel}" && if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Pulling $MODEL..." && ollama pull $MODEL; else echo '✗ Ollama not installed. Run: Install Qwen Models task'; fi
tasks.detail: Pull a specific Qwen model using Ollama
